Package com.compdfkit.core.document

Class CPDFOutline

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.document.CPDFOutline
public class CPDFOutline extends Object
A document outline (or "table of contents entry"), usually the header of a chapter. Outline objects can be retrieved via getChildList(). They can carry an Action and thus allow quick navigation to document pages, or even external resources.
